column1: # Carrier-panel genes (docs/design/genomics.md sections 2.2 rule 9, 6 and 7): the genes of the producer's
# couple carrier screen, copied from OwnGenome assets/carrier_genes.tsv (commit bb4ef0ab24f7, 2026-11-05),
# columns gene, chrom, start, end, inheritance and lists. GRCh38 spans (1-based, closed) from the gene
# lines of GENCODE release 50 (basic annotation). lists: ACMG (Gregg et al. 2021, tier 3), ACOG
# (Committee Opinions 690 and 691) or Orphanet (AR or X-linked disorders). A carrier fact may cite only
# positions inside these spans, and a minor's raw lookups inside them are withheld. Lookups pad each
# span by SPAN_PAD_BP. Update this file from OwnGenome when its list changes.
